scope: Actual anonymous Chrome release check. Two different signed reports were opened sequentially using report/view fragments. The second same-document navigation retained the first report. This is a product failure, not a provider failure or evidence of a successful final release check.

observed.assertion: Requirements conflict row was absent; the accessibility snapshot still showed the earlier one-claim report.

cause: The report page verified location.hash only on initial mount and did not observe hashchange.
resolution: Listen for fragment changes, clear prior results, and ignore obsolete asynchronous verification completions. A controlled browser regression covers changed valid fragments, invalid fragments and back navigation. Final passing readback is recorded separately.
